text: I've been a patient of this clinic for over 10 years and have been to other clinics but ended up coming back here. It's good and cheap. I've had root canals and crowns for ten years without any problems. The receptionists are more polite now. Go ahead and make an appointment and go on time. If any doctor does a bad job, tell them. restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตแพทย์ประเทือง มีนบุรี
text:
As someone who has been a regular here for over five years, primarily for scaling, I've been consistently "degraded" in recent times. The most recent visit was yesterday, March 11, 2023, when I used my social security benefits to get a dental scaling and filling service. What I really couldn't accept was the doctor's method of scaling. He used a grinding tool to poke into the gums and pry them out, rather than gently scraping away the tartar. The grinding tool also constantly touched my lips, making it feel like it wasn't the right method. The mouth cover was too far off the top of my mouth, causing the rinse water to soak my throat. The assistant barely participated, despite always being there to assist me. After about 10 minutes of rinsing, I discovered a small blood clot. I experienced a burning sensation and pain throughout my mouth, my lips were swollen, and some areas looked burnt. This will be my last visit and I will never return.

P.S. I asked a friend who also visited at a different time and they had the same experience. Some were in tears, while others required anti-inflammatory and painkillers. The scaling procedure was quite different. It doesn't have to be that torturous. Anyone thinking of using this service should really consider it. If we continue to lower our service levels like this, it's sure to be a disaster for a long time.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตแพทย์ประเทือง มีนบุรี
text: I've been using this clinic for over ten years and have seen very negative changes in everything – the condition of the clinic, the staff, and the dentists. I'm baffled by the dentist's diagnosis; based on an examination of the patient's gums, they said this case was difficult and recommended a specialist. I read the comments before my visit but didn't believe them because I've been getting treatment from this clinic for so long, and they've always done the right thing. However, their response was exactly as described in the patient complaints. If they only offer simple procedures, they should have stated that they only do fillings and extractions, or that they don't handle difficult cases because they're not skilled at them. That would be better than wasting the patient's time and travel expenses. I recommend you avoid this clinic.
